summary: A disputed endorsement forces officials to check which other recommendations depended on it.
realLife: Staff reported that the township and county supported Lake Killian believing the Scout council had endorsed it as an organization.
inGame: needs: the sponsor’s correction and the reasons the county and township gave for their recommendations.

turns.what: The clerk sends the correction to the county.
turns.pulledBy: The county cites the sponsor as its reason.
turns.writesBack: The county recommendation is flagged for a reply.

turns.pulledBy: The township confirms its own reasons.
turns.writesBack: The township position can stand independently.
